identificationModule.briefTitle: Phase II Clinical Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of HLX07+HLX10 +mFOLFOX6 or HLX07 Monotherapy in Patients With mCRC
identificationModule.officialTitle: An Open-label, Multicenter, Phase II Clinical Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of HLX07 (Recombinant Humanized Anti-EGFR Monoclonal Antibody Injection) + HLX10 (Recombinant Humanized Anti-PD-1 Monoclonal Antibody Injection) + mFOLFOX6 or HLX07 Monotherapy in Patients With Metastatic Colorectal Cancer

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This is An Open-label, Multicenter, Phase II Clinical Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of HLX07 (Recombinant Humanized Anti-EGFR Monoclonal Antibody Injection) + HLX10 (Recombinant Humanized Anti-PD-1 Monoclonal Antibody Injection) + mFOLFOX6 or HLX07 Monotherapy in Patients with Metastatic Colorectal Cancer.

primaryOutcomes.description: Objective response rate (assessed by investigator per RECIST V1.1)
Progression-free survival (PFS) (assessed by the investigator per RECIST v1.1 )
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: : from the first dose until firstly confirmed and recorded disease progression or death (whichever occurs earlier)，up to 3 years

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age\>=18Y and ≤75Y
* Good Organ Function
* Expected survival time ≥ 3 months
* mCRC that have been diagnosed histologically
* KRAS/NRAS/BRAF WT verified by PCR or NGS of tumor tissue
* ECOG score 0-1;

Exclusion Criteria:

* HIV infection
* Active clinical severe infection;
* A history of other malignancies within two years, except for cured carcinoma in situ of the cervix or basal cell carcinoma of the skin.
